subject: Sealed-environment deployment — readiness follow-up
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Hayes <ellen.hayes@genomicelabs.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@genomicelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sealed-environment deploy readiness — follow-up and clarifying questions

Thanks for the time this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and a handful of clarifying questions so we can finalize the scope for a sealed (air‑gapped) Private deployment and get the mutual action plan moving.

Recap (from our call)
- Preferred deployment: Private, fully-sealed network (no outbound telemetry).
- Objective: Host Redwood appliance on-site to serve inference for research workloads; strict controls on patching and image delivery.
- Next milestone: onsite environmental survey + BOM confirmation + MOP signoff.

Clarifying questions (please flag any items you want to discuss further):
1) Physical access: who on your side will be the designated build/ops liaisons with badge/clearance to receive sealed crates and accept hardware? Name + contact + expected on-site windows.
2) Patching cadence: is monthly maintenance acceptable, or do you require quarterly-only firmware updates? We need to coordinate a signed offline image delivery process if monthly is not allowed.
3) Transport media policy: can you accept encrypted, signed USB images couriered by an approved carrier, or do you require courier-free hand-off (local PKI signing of images)?
4) Time/NTP: do you permit NTP to the public internet, or must we support a local NTP/GPS stratum for the appliance?
5) HSM/KMS: will you provide an HSM/KMS on-prem for key storage, or do you want Redwood to manage an HSM appliance that we ship?
6) Spares and uptime: what’s your required RTO for hardware failures (e.g., 24h on-site replacement vs onsite swap by your team)?

Attachments I will send next: a first‑draft MOP (mechanics of the offline image install), BOM for recommended spares, and an example signed-image manifest.

Proposed next steps:
- Please reply with answers to the 6 items above and preferred dates for an environmental survey (we can do 21–23 Mar or week of 27 Mar).
- If procurement wants cost/PO cadence, CC them so we can share a draft commercial SOW and a procurement checklist.

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Ellen Hayes <ellen.hayes@genomicelabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@genomicelabs.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@genomicelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 16:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sealed-environment deploy readiness — follow-up and clarifying questions

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline: 

1) Physical access: Primary build contact is Samir Khan (samir.k@genomicelabs.com, +1 617-555-2222). He and 1 SOC engineer will have badge access. Delivery must be scheduled 48h in advance.

2) Patching cadence: Standard policy is quarterly only for OS/firmware unless critical CVE. We can allow a separate security patch window if Redwood certifies the image as signed and provides test MOP.

3) Transport media: We cannot accept external couriers bringing unvetted USBs into the sealed zone. We prefer a sealed courier handoff at security desk where images are transferred to an internal write-once key device provided by us. If Redwood can provide a signed image + SHA256 manifest, we’ll use our internal transfer process.

4) Time/NTP: No external NTP allowed. We have a stratum-1 internal NTP server (IP provided during the survey).

5) HSM/KMS: We can provide a Thales HSM in our secure vault. Redwood must support HSM integration and an offline key injection procedure.

6) Spares and uptime: Target RTO is 48 hours on-site replacement. We expect Redwood to provide a recommended spare kit and an SOP for hot-swap of GPUs/PSUs.

We also need a redlines-friendly mutual action plan (high level) so procurement can map milestones to PO terms. Can you send a first-pass MOP and spare kit BOM by EOD tomorrow?

Appreciate it — Ellen

--
Dr. Ellen Hayes
CIO, Genomicelabs
ellen.hayes@genomicelabs.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Hayes <ellen.hayes@genomicelabs.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@genomicelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@genomicelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sealed-environment deploy readiness — next steps and proposed deliverables

Thanks Ellen — this is helpful and clears up a lot. Action items and commitments from Redwood below.

Redwood commitments (draft):
- Offline image delivery: Redwood will produce a signed image bundle and SHA256 manifest. We’ll provide instructions for your internal write-once key ingestion and will not ship unsigned media.
- MOP: attached draft (SealedDeploy-MOP-v1.2.pdf). Includes acceptance checklist and tests we run during on-site verification (service start, KV cache warming, sample inference tests using a sanitized prompt suite).
- Spare kit BOM: attached (spare-kits-BOM.xlsx). Recommendation: 2x GPU modules, 1x redundant PSU, 1x swap HDD, consumables. We’ll work to meet a 48h RTO with coordinated logistics — please confirm preferred vendor for courier handoff if needed.
- HSM integration: Rishi will lead the HSM key-injection procedure and provide a dry-run plan for your security desk.
- Maintenance window: propose a monthly 2-hour window for minor updates and a quarterly firmware window for anything that touches bootloader/firmware. You flagged quarterly-only policy; we can respect that and treat monthly windows as optional for patched-only micro-updates that do not modify firmware.

Proposed next steps (concrete):
1) Genomicelabs: confirm Samir as build lead and provide badge access window estimates & internal NTP IP.
2) Redwood: Ben will schedule an environmental survey for 21–23 Mar (tentative).
3) Procurement: we’ll follow up with a redlines-friendly MAP and commercial SOW by Thu 8 Mar.
4) Logistics: agree courier/hand-off SOP during the survey.

Attachments included: SealedDeploy-MOP-v1.2.pdf; spare-kits-BOM.xlsx; signed-image-manifest.sha256.txt (manifest is sample only).

Ben — I’m flagging you to own the survey scheduling and the follow-up SOW. Rishi — can you schedule a 30m HSM integration call with Samir this week?

Thanks — Naomi
